The only domestic-facing trace is a single outbound row on the Hyderabad namesake page: '2024-12-30 | DEVI ENTERPRISE | EXALT DRUK ENVIROKLENS LTD | UP 250/46 PUMP KIRLOSKAR MAKE HORIZONTALCENTRIFUGAL SPLIT CASE PUMP MODEL-UP 250/46 HAVING HEAD-60.00M WITH ACCESSORIES | Chamurchi, India -> SAMSTE BHUTAN, BHUTAN | HS 84137010 | BOL 6882043' — this is an export to Bhutan by the Hyderabad entity, not domestic supply, and not attributable to the claimed proprietor.
note: Attribution unresolved, so both statuses are 'unknown' rather than confirmed/declared_only. The claimed proprietor 'SHANTABEN LALJI KERAI' is a Kutch/Gujarat-style name and the Mirzapar (Bhuj, Kachchh) granite exporter is geographically plausible, but no public record links the two: the proprietor-named importkey page carries no shipment rows, and the Mirzapar page shows no proprietor field. The 605-record Mirzapar entity is a granite/marble slab exporter via Mundra Sea to Kenya and Uganda (HS 68022390, 25161200, 63079099) — note this differs from the declared HS 680293 (worked monumental/building stone), which is a related but not identical heading; per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground and the code should be corrected to the observed 68022390 if this entity is confirmed as the supplier. The Hyderabad 'DEVI ENTERPRISES' (furniture/flooring importer, HS 94018000, 44187500, 57032910) is a clearly different company and must not be merged. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN, revenue or export value is public in the sources read — all left null, nothing inferred. Limitation: the web_search tool returned 'searx: Connection refused' on every attempt and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, so no GST portal, GeM/CPPP or second-source cross-check was possible; the attribution gap and the domestic-supply gap are open, not negative findings. No evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy was found, so no rejection ground applies.
